title: Asajj Ventress
subtitle: Bounty Hunter
description: Asajj Ventress served a very unconventional role during the Clone Wars. Asajj was born on the harsh planet of Dathomir and was a member of the Nightsisters, a coven of powerful witches that resided on the planet. Ventress yearned to be a Sith, but even after being hired and trained by Count Dooku as an assassin, he refused her the honor. In the end, Dooku betrayed her and Asajj found a new life.
